Hi Sara — great to hear, welcome onboard.

Short answers:
- Yes, please name "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Certificate Holder and list Redwood as Additional Insured on the Commercial General Liability policy.
- Coverage minima we require: Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence; General Aggregate: $2,000,000; Umbrella/Excess: $5,000,000. For cyber/e&O we request at least $1,000,000 if you're handling any sensitive data.
- PO routing: Finance sends the DocuSign PO from procurement@redwood.com (you can expect a doc to sign). For some strategic suppliers we'll issue a portal-based PO — we'll flag that in the DocuSign cover note.

I'm attaching our COI template to this thread for reference; Marcus (legal) and Lauren (finance) are looped for any redlines.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Receive COI from your broker with "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured and Certificate Holder.
2) Return the COI and the Vendor_Onboarding_Form (you already sent it — thanks).
3) Expect a DocuSign PO from procurement@redwood.com within 48–72 hours after Finance completes the vendor code.

If you need the change to the indemnity language or higher limits, let us know now so finance/legal can review before issuing the PO.

Best,
